description: This source file defines the SecurityHeadersMiddleware class responsible for adding various security-related HTTP headers to responses in an ASP.NET Core application. It also includes an extension method to register the middleware in the application's request pipeline.

classes.name: SecurityHeadersMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware adding common security headers including CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.

methods.name: SecurityHeadersMiddleware.RequestDelegate
methods.description: Assigned in the constructor to invoke the next middleware in the pipeline.

methods.name: SecurityHeadersMiddleware.Invoke
methods.description: Method that adds security headers to the HTTP response and invokes the next middleware.

methods.name: SecurityHeadersMiddlewareExtensions.UseSecurityHeaders
methods.description: Extension method to add the SecurityHeadersMiddleware to the application's request pipeline.
